title: S6: gate scorer adapter, GlyphIndex to the held-out ground truth (ADR 0008)
description: Score a GlyphIndex against the committed click 7.1.2 ground truth under both denominators and both precision sides per DEC-303 (a2)/(a3); site-level Wilson gates, cluster bootstrap for information; per-bin unresolved shares beside recall. Built and tested against stub indexes, no analyzer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The scorer reports recall under the all-attributable and pyright-comparable denominators and precision on the independent and comparable sides, site-level Wilson and a cluster bootstrap, per Addendum 4
Tests with stub indexes pin the numbers both ways and a mutation of each convention changes the output

implementationNotes: S6 landed at 341692f (Sonnet specialist).
